# Ali Rizvi and Ashley Stirrup
Date: 2026-10-02 | Duration: 33.130001068115234m

## Summary
The discussion focused on restructuring inadequate financial reporting and revenue recognition processes. Revenue and ARR are manually estimated from Stripe and HubSpot, with unclear deferred revenue, amortization, ownership, and methodology. Jeremy’s investor spreadsheet remains the main source for revenue and cash metrics but is not integrated with accounting systems. Accounts receivable reached $4.4 million, with a target of $2 million. Ali plans to review Fondo’s accounting practices, gain access to QuickBooks Online, Stripe, and HubSpot, and clarify cash balances, vendor management, and expense categorization. Mark’s financial model is outdated, hard-coded, missing accounts payable, and does not include next year’s hiring or budget; Ali plans to rebuild it for fiscal year 2027. Runway estimates range from the low 20s to about 25 months, with a goal of 24 months by January end supported by a $2 million Anthropic services deal, of which $500,000 has been collected. The company also needs formal monthly closes, bank reconciliations, cash collection targets, vendor classification, a COGS policy, clearer outsourcing accountability, and stricter adherence to approved hiring plans.

## Keywords
Accounting, Revenue Recognition, Cash Collections, Financial Modeling, Expense Classification, Outsourced Bookkeeping

## Action Items

**Ali Rizvi**
Send link to shared folder containing the latest spreadsheet from Mark (01:06)
Review Fondo’s accounting procedures through a direct call; identify responsibilities and gaps (14:03)
Obtain access to company’s QuickBooks Online and HubSpot instances to analyze financial data and revenue recognition processes (20:18)
Coordinate communication via Slack with Jennifer and request Slack invite to relevant channels (21:40)
Conduct a detailed line-by-line review of accounting entries with outsourced bookkeepers (14:03)
Meet with Mark for rebuilding the FY2028 financial model to align with hiring and financial planning (25:26)
Prepare comprehensive list of accounting and financial planning gaps for leadership review (24:30)
Establish a monthly close cadence and financial reporting framework with accounting team (23:58)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Coordinate with Jennifer to send Slack invite to Ali (21:11)
Share investor spreadsheet and company operational metrics with Ali for better transparency (04:44)
Assist in identifying and tagging all vendors and contractors for proper expense classification (15:05)
Facilitate contact between Ali and Fondo’s team, especially Nick, to clarify roles and responsibilities (20:44)
Communicate leadership’s headcount and hiring plan limits to team to improve budgeting discipline (27:16)

# Ali Rizvi and Ashley Stirrup
Date: 2026-10-13 | Duration: 29.670000076293945m

## Summary
The discussion centered on creating reliable financial visibility and stronger cash management. Ali committed to producing a monthly cash runway report after receiving access to HubSpot, Orb, and Stripe, alongside existing QuickBooks access; the current runway estimate ranges from 10 to 25 months because it uses only current-month cash consumption. A 13-week rolling cash flow forecast was also proposed. Collections require improvement because Ryan, the CRO, is managing them without prior experience, payment delays are unclear, and DSO is not currently tracked, though Ali estimates it is in the high 40s to 50s. The group discussed moving financial support from Fondo to Ativo, improving the 5–7-business-day month-end close, standardizing vendor expense reviews, and replacing Jeremy’s manual investor spreadsheet process. A recurring financial review was proposed for late October, with weekly progress summaries from Ali. Ashley and Ali also agreed to assess venture debt and clarify process ownership across finance, operations, and sales.

## Keywords
cash reporting, cash runway, collections process, financial reporting, accrual accounting, vendor expense categorization

## Action Items

**Ali Rizvi**
Deliver monthly Cash Runway report including spend, collection, and burn rate analysis urgently by Oct 20 (02:00)
Build rolling 13-week cash flow forecast model requiring access to Orbit and Stripe (06:50)
Request and confirm access to HubSpot, Orb, and Stripe data systems to enable accurate cash flow reporting (07:30)
Schedule process improvement meeting with key stakeholders on Oct 22 or 23 and prepare agenda focused on financial processes (10:30)
Meet Ryan McGurk (CRO) to discuss collections process and assess Ativo’s capability for collection support (17:45)
Investigate Fondo’s accounting practices and prepare transition info/resources for potential shift to Ativo, including reviewing current contract for notice periods (13:30)
Prepare and send weekly email summaries updating team on progress and next steps, with optional cc to Jeremy and others (27:20)
Review debt facility details and discuss potential strategic use (27:00)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Grant Ali view-only access to HubSpot and coordinate access to Orb and Stripe, copying involved parties for clarity (07:10)
Coordinate calendar schedules and send invites for process improvement meeting on suggested date/time (Oct 22 or 23 at noon Pacific) (10:40)
Facilitate Slack connection between Ali and Ryan McGurk for collections discussions (19:45)
Push internal resolution regarding who can provide Orb and Stripe access (08:40)
Review and consider Fondo contract terms in preparation for transition discussions (15:40)
Initiate vendor expense categorization review and process documentation alongside Ali’s improvements (21:50)

**Jeremy**
Respond to Orbit and Stripe access facilitation requests that Ashley is coordinating (08:50)
